title: MV State chance when using action effect more than once

posts.author: Vyndicate
posts.body:
When using action effect, it will give a double action, including buff and debuff
For buff and debuff, there's a add command to do it, but how to make it add buff when the it's not miss?
For state also have it, but how to make it apply state with a chance of certain percentage?
I was using YEP Action Sequences
Edit:
Additional question, how to make buff/debuff/state apply only once even multiple action effect occurs?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:

For buff and debuff, there's a add command to do it, but how to make it add buff when the it's not miss?

Are you saying that you want the skill to buff the user and debuff the target, but the buff should happen even if it misses and the debuff requires it to hit? Since you're already using AS, you can just use the command and specify the user
Vyndicate said:
For state also have it, but how to make it apply state with a chance of certain percentage?
Click to expand...
Use an IF statement and have the state be the result of the check or just use the engine's built in effects and itll run any time the action effect is triggered
Code:
if Math.random() < .80
  add state 42: target
end

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
Vyndicate said:
This one cause the debuff keep applied even all the attack missed, maybe I go enhance the plugin to apply only when enemy get hit at least once
Click to expand...
It depends on what specifically you want. Anything done within the effects box will be done to the target if the skill hit, so if there's a thing you want done to the target and requires a hit, put it there.
Within an AS, you can specify effects to go on either the user or the target, but anything done in an AS will be done regardless of if the skill hit or not. At that point, you will need to use an IF statement after the
action effect
command to see if the skill hit and to do the AS effects if it did.
Code:
if target.result().isHit()
  add state 42: user
end

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
You got it working so you could leave it there if you like, but as a suggestion for later skills - You could have cut down out most of that by using
Serge's loop extension
or by using Yanfly's skill core's <Post-Damage Eval> notetag to set that applyEffect property automatically on any successful hit and only check for it at the end, or by using both plugins.
In any case, the issue has been solved. I'll be closing the thread now. No need for another report unless you want to re-open it for any reason
